instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Modern Trends: Zero Trust, AI Auditing, ESG
topic_ar: الاتجاهات الحديثة: الثقة الصفرية والذكاء وESG

questions.question: Which slogan captures the Zero Trust policy?
questions.question_ar: أي شعار يلخّص سياسة الثقة الصفرية؟
options: Never Trust, Always Verify.
Trust but verify everything.
Trust the internal network.
Verify once, then trust.
options_ar: ثق لكن تحقّق من كل شيء دائماً.
تحقّق مرة واحدة ثم ثق دائماً.
options_en: Never Trust, Always Verify.
Trust but verify everything.
Trust the internal network.
Verify once, then trust.
questions.explanation: Never Trust, Always Verify. Trust is never granted by location, only by verification.
questions.explanation_ar: لا تثق أبداً، تحقّق دائماً. الثقة لا تُمنح بالمكان بل بالتحقق.

questions.question: What assumption does Zero Trust reject?
options: The role of least privilege in policy.
The idea that being inside means trusted.
The need for any authentication at all.
The use of encryption on the network here.
options_ar: فكرة أن الوجود بالداخل يعني الثقة.
الحاجة إلى أي مصادقة إطلاقاً هنا.
options_en: The role of least privilege in policy.
The idea that being inside means trusted.
The need for any authentication at all.
The use of encryption on the network here.
questions.explanation: Perimeter security assumed that inside means trusted. Zero Trust rejects exactly that, which is why the perimeter stops being the boundary.
questions.explanation_ar: أمن المحيط افترض أن الداخل موثوق. والثقة الصفرية ترفض ذلك بالضبط، ولهذا يتوقف المحيط عن كونه الحدّ.

questions.question: What happens to every access request?
options: Every request is logged and nothing more.
Every request is approved by a manager.
Every request is verified continuously.
Every request is trusted once it is inside.
options_ar: كل طلب يُسجَّل ولا شيء أكثر.
كل طلب يوافق عليه مدير مسؤول.
كل طلب يُوثَق به بعد الدخول.
options_en: Every request is logged and nothing more.
Every request is approved by a manager.
Every request is verified continuously.
Every request is trusted once it is inside.
questions.explanation: Every access request is verified continuously, not once at the door.
questions.explanation_ar: كل طلب وصول يُتحقَّق منه باستمرار، لا مرة واحدة عند الباب.

questions.question: Which three things happen to every user, device and request?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاثة أمور تحدث لكل مستخدم وجهاز وطلب؟
options: Logged, archived, and then securely deleted.
Approved, budgeted, and scheduled.
Encrypted, compressed, and stored.
Authenticated, authorised, and encrypted.
options_en: Logged, archived, and then securely deleted.
Approved, budgeted, and scheduled.
Encrypted, compressed, and stored.
Authenticated, authorised, and encrypted.
questions.explanation: Every user, device and request is authenticated, authorized and encrypted. All three, every time.
questions.explanation_ar: كل مستخدم وجهاز وطلب يُصادَق عليه ويُصرَّح به ويُشفَّر. الثلاثة، في كل مرة.

questions.question: How does Zero Trust handle least privilege?
questions.question_ar: كيف تتعامل الثقة الصفرية مع الامتياز الأدنى؟
options: It is enforced dynamically, per request.
It is written once in the policy document.
It is granted to the whole department.
It is reviewed once every five years.
options_en: It is enforced dynamically, per request.
It is written once in the policy document.
It is granted to the whole department.
It is reviewed once every five years.
questions.explanation: Least privilege is enforced dynamically, so the permissions follow the request rather than the person's job title.
questions.explanation_ar: الامتياز الأدنى يُفرَض ديناميكياً، فالصلاحيات تتبع الطلب لا المسمّى الوظيفي.

questions.question: What does the Zero Trust example require?
options: The internal network is trusted by default here.
Sensitive transactions need re-authentication.
Staff sign in once at the start of the day.
Managers approve each transaction manually.
options_ar: الموظفون يسجّلون الدخول مرة في الصباح.
options_en: The internal network is trusted by default here.
Sensitive transactions need re-authentication.
Staff sign in once at the start of the day.
Managers approve each transaction manually.
questions.explanation: A sensitive transaction demands re-authentication even when the person is already inside the corporate network.
questions.explanation_ar: العملية الحساسة تفرض تحققاً جديداً حتى لو كان الشخص داخل شبكة المؤسسة أصلاً.

questions.question: What is wrong with manual compliance audits?
questions.question_ar: ما مشكلة التدقيق اليدوي على الامتثال؟
options: They run continuously without any staff.
They replace the need for any policy.
They are resource-intensive and error-prone.
They are cheap and always completely accurate.
options_ar: تغني عن الحاجة إلى أي سياسة هنا.
options_en: They run continuously without any staff.
They replace the need for any policy.
They are resource-intensive and error-prone.
They are cheap and always completely accurate.
questions.explanation: Manual audits are resource-intensive and error-prone, which is exactly the gap AI-driven auditing is sold to fill.
questions.explanation_ar: التدقيق اليدوي مكلف بالموارد ومعرّض للخطأ، وهذا بالضبط الفراغ الذي يُطرح التدقيق بالذكاء لملئه.

questions.question: What do AI auditing tools do with the logs?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تفعل أدوات التدقيق بالذكاء بالسجلات؟
options: They replace the raw logs with dashboards.
They audit once at the end of the year.
They delete the logs after each audit.
They monitor logs and flag non-compliance.
options_ar: تدقّق مرة واحدة في نهاية السنة هنا.
تحذف السجلات بعد كل تدقيق أمني.
options_en: They replace the raw logs with dashboards.
They audit once at the end of the year.
They delete the logs after each audit.
They monitor logs and flag non-compliance.
questions.explanation: They monitor the logs and detect non-compliant behaviour in real time, rather than reconstructing it months later.
questions.explanation_ar: تراقب السجلات وترصد السلوك غير الممتثل في الوقت الحقيقي، بدل إعادة بنائه بعد أشهر.

questions.question: Which standards do AI tools map compliance gaps against?
questions.question_ar: بأي معايير تربط أدوات الذكاء فجوات الامتثال؟
options: They map gaps against ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
They map gaps against the marketing plan.
They map gaps against last year's budget.
They map gaps against the current staff roster.
options_ar: تربط الفجوات بمعايير ISO 27001 و NIST CSF.
تربط الفجوات بخطة التسويق السنوية هنا تماماً.
تربط الفجوات بميزانية العام الماضي هنا.
تربط الفجوات بكشف الموظفين الحالي هنا.
options_en: They map gaps against ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
They map gaps against the marketing plan.
They map gaps against last year's budget.
They map gaps against the current staff roster.
questions.explanation: They map the gaps automatically against ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF, so the mapping no longer waits for a consultant.
questions.explanation_ar: تربط الفجوات تلقائياً بمعيار ISO 27001 وإطار NIST CSF، فلم يعد الربط ينتظر مستشاراً.

questions.question: How do AI tools predict risk?
options: By counting how many policies exist here.
By correlating violations with attack likelihood.
By asking each department for its own risk forecast.
By reading the annual audit report only here.
options_ar: بسؤال كل قسم عن توقعه الخاص.
options_en: By counting how many policies exist here.
By correlating violations with attack likelihood.
By asking each department for its own risk forecast.
By reading the annual audit report only here.
questions.explanation: They predict risk by correlating policy violations with the likelihood of an attack, which turns a violation into a probability.
questions.explanation_ar: تتوقع الخطر بربط المخالفات باحتمال الهجوم، فتحوّل المخالفة إلى احتمال.

questions.question: What does AI-driven compliance actually achieve?
options: Policies no longer need any human review at all.
Policies become optional for all of the staff.
Policies stay actively enforced, not just written.
Policies are written once and then archived here for good.
options_ar: لم تعد السياسات تحتاج أي مراجعة بشرية.
تبقى السياسات مفروضة فعلياً لا مكتوبة فقط.
تُكتب السياسات مرة واحدة ثم تُؤرشف هنا تماماً.
options_en: Policies no longer need any human review at all.
Policies become optional for all of the staff.
Policies stay actively enforced, not just written.
Policies are written once and then archived here for good.
questions.explanation: It reduces human workload and keeps policies actively enforced instead of merely written, which is the whole point of monitoring.
questions.explanation_ar: يقلّل عبء العمل البشري ويُبقي السياسات مفروضة فعلياً لا مكتوبة فقط، وهذا هو مغزى المراقبة.

questions.question: How does cybersecurity map onto the three ESG pillars?
questions.question_ar: كيف يرتبط الأمن السيبراني بأركان ESG الثلاثة؟
options: Governance budgets, social events, environmental PR.
Governance audits, social media, environmental law.
Governance policy, social training, environmental tax.
Governance ethics, social trust, environmental IT.
options_ar: تدقيق حوكمة وتواصل اجتماعي وقانون بيئي.
سياسة حوكمة وتدريب اجتماعي وضريبة بيئية.
حوكمة أخلاقية وثقة اجتماعية وتقنية بيئية.
options_en: Governance budgets, social events, environmental PR.
Governance audits, social media, environmental law.
Governance policy, social training, environmental tax.
Governance ethics, social trust, environmental IT.
questions.explanation: Governance covers the ethical handling of data, Social covers customer trust and employee privacy, Environmental covers sustainable IT such as green data centres.
questions.explanation_ar: الحوكمة تغطي التعامل الأخلاقي مع البيانات، والاجتماعي يغطي ثقة العملاء وخصوصية الموظفين، والبيئي يغطي تقنية مستدامة كمراكز البيانات الخضراء.
